```lua
end)

if player.Character then
	task.spawn(onCharacter, player.Character)
end
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacter)
```

The key is held, not toggled, so letting go always stands the player up, and the speed and hip height are remembered at the moment of crouching so values changed by other scripts (like a sprint) are restored correctly. I did not hard-code an animation asset id because crouch animations are not a standard Roblox asset; add your own through the `CrouchAnimationId` attribute and it will play over the procedural lowering.

**Plan**
- On every spawn the script turns off `BreakJointsOnDeath` and `RequiresNeck` so the body stays assembled when the Humanoid dies.
- On `Humanoid.Died`, each Motor6D gets a pair of Attachments positioned at its C0 and C1, joined by a `BallSocketConstraint` with twist limits, and the Motor6D is disabled.
- Limbs are made collidable (the root part is not), and the character gets a `Ragdolled` attribute; the whole conversion runs on the server so everybody sees the same ragdoll.

```lua
--!strict
-- Script (ServerScriptService/RagdollOnDeath)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local TWIST_LIMIT = 45
local SWING_LIMIT = 70

local function ragdoll(character: Model)
	if character:GetAttribute("Ragdolled") then
		return
	end
	character:SetAttribute("Ragdolled", true)

	for _, descendant in character:GetDescendants() do
		if descendant:IsA("Motor6D") then
			local motor = descendant
			local part0 = motor.Part0
			local part1 = motor.Part1
			if part0 and part1 then
				local attachment0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
				attachment0.Name = "RagdollAttachment0"
				attachment0.CFrame = motor.C0
				local attachment1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
				attachment1.Name = "RagdollAttachment1"
				attachment1.CFrame = motor.C1

				local socket = Instance.new("BallSocketConstraint")
				socket.Name = "RagdollSocket"
				socket.Attachment0 = attachment0
				socket.Attachment1 = attachment1
				socket.LimitsEnabled = true
				socket.UpperAngle = SWING_LIMIT
				socket.TwistLimitsEnabled = true
				socket.TwistLowerAngle = -TWIST_LIMIT
				socket.TwistUpperAngle = TWIST_LIMIT

				attachment0.Parent = part0
				attachment1.Parent = part1
				socket.Parent = part0
				motor.Enabled = false
			end
		elseif descendant:IsA("BasePart") and descendant.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
			descendant.CanCollide = true
		end
	end
end

local function onCharacter(character: Model)
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid") :: Humanoid
	humanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
	humanoid.RequiresNeck = false
	humanoid.Died:Once(function()
		ragdoll(character)
	end)
end

local function onPlayer(player: Player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacter)
	if player.Character then
		task.spawn(onCharacter, player.Character)
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayer)
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	onPlayer(player)
end
```

A Motor6D is a rigid joint with offsets `C0` (on Part0) and `C1` (on Part1). Placing an Attachment at each offset and joining them with a BallSocketConstraint keeps the limbs in the same relative positions but lets them swing within limits, which is what a ragdoll is. The `Ragdolled` attribute guards against converting twice, so the same `ragdoll` function could also be called for knock-backs.

**Plan**
- The Tool (set `RequiresHandle = false`) holds this Script and the same source as a LocalScript; the server creates a `Fire` RemoteEvent inside the Tool and the client sends `mouse.Hit.Position` when the tool is activated.
- The server validates that the sender is holding the tool, the target is a Vector3 between 3 and 150 studs away and the cooldown is over, then raycasts itself to find the real surface so the client cannot lie about where it hit.
- It builds a `RopeConstraint` between an Attachment on the root part and one on the hit surface and turns on the winch, which shortens the rope and pulls the player toward the point; clicking again, unequipping, dying or 4 seconds cleans it up.

```lua
--!strict
-- Script (inside the Tool "GrapplingHook" in StarterPack). The identical source is also saved as a LocalScript inside the same Tool (it branches on RunService).
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local tool = script.Parent :: Tool

local MAX_RANGE = 150
local MIN_RANGE = 3
local COOLDOWN = 1.5
local MAX_HOLD = 4

if RunService:IsServer() then
	local remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	remote.Name = "Fire"
	remote.Parent = tool

	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local rope: RopeConstraint? = nil
	local created: { Instance } = {}
	local lastShot = 0.0

	local function release()
		if rope then
			rope:Destroy()
			rope = nil
		end
		for _, instance in created do
			instance:Destroy()
		end
		table.clear(created)
	end

	remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, target: unknown)
		local character = player.Character
		if not character or tool.Parent ~= character then
			return
		end
		if rope then
			release()
			return
		end
		if typeof(target) ~= "Vector3" then
			return
		end
		local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			return
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		local offset = target - root.Position
		if now - lastShot < COOLDOWN or not (offset.Magnitude >= MIN_RANGE and offset.Magnitude <= MAX_RANGE) then
			return
		end
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, offset.Unit * (offset.Magnitude + 2), params)
		if not hit then
			return
		end
		lastShot = now

		local startAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
		local endAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
		endAttachment.CFrame = hit.Instance.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(CFrame.new(hit.Position))
		local newRope = Instance.new("RopeConstraint")
		newRope.Attachment0 = startAttachment
		newRope.Attachment1 = endAttachment
		newRope.Length = (hit.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
		newRope.Visible = true
		newRope.Thickness = 0.15
		newRope.Color = BrickColor.new("Dark stone grey")
		newRope.WinchEnabled = true
		newRope.WinchTarget = 6
		newRope.WinchSpeed = 40
		newRope.WinchForce = 25000
		newRope.WinchResponsiveness = 40

		startAttachment.Parent = root
		endAttachment.Parent = hit.Instance
		newRope.Parent = root
		table.insert(created, startAttachment)
		table.insert(created, endAttachment)
		rope = newRope
		humanoid.Died:Once(release)
		task.delay(MAX_HOLD, function()
			if rope == newRope then
				release()
			end
		end)
	end)
	tool.Unequipped:Connect(release)
else
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local remote = tool:WaitForChild("Fire") :: RemoteEvent
	local mouse = Players.LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
	tool.Activated:Connect(function()
		remote:FireServer(mouse.Hit.Position)
	end)
end
```

The client only reports where the mouse is pointing, and everything that matters is decided by the server: it re-casts the ray from the player's real position, so a spoofed hit position can only ever attach the rope to something actually in the line of sight, within 150 studs. The rope's winch pulls the player to 6 studs from the anchor point at 40 studs/s, and the next click, unequipping or dying releases it.

**Plan**
- Zombie models (Humanoid + HumanoidRootPart) carry the tag `Zombie`; each gets its own loop that runs every 0.25 s on the server and takes network ownership away from clients.
- Every tick it finds the nearest living player; within 50 studs it chases and, within 5 studs, stops and attacks once every 1.2 s with `TakeDamage` (so ForceFields still protect).
- With nobody in range it wanders: every 3-6 seconds it picks a random point within 30 studs of its home position and walks there at a slower speed.

```lua
--!strict
-- Script (ServerScriptService/ZombieAI). Tag zombie models (Humanoid + HumanoidRootPart) with "Zombie".
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local TAG = "Zombie"
local CHASE_RANGE = 50
local ATTACK_RANGE = 5
local ATTACK_DAMAGE = 12
local ATTACK_COOLDOWN = 1.2
local WANDER_RADIUS = 30
local TICK = 0.25
local rng = Random.new()
local function nearestPlayer(position: Vector3): (Model?, BasePart?, number)
	local bestCharacter: Model? = nil
	local bestRoot: BasePart? = nil
	local bestDistance = math.huge
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local character = player.Character
		local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		if character and root and root:IsA("BasePart") and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			local distance = (root.Position - position).Magnitude
			if distance < bestDistance then
				bestCharacter, bestRoot, bestDistance = character, root, distance
			end
		end
	end
	return bestCharacter, bestRoot, bestDistance
end
local function run(zombie: Model)
	local humanoid = zombie:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = zombie:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoid or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end
	pcall(function()
		root:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
	end)
	local home = root.Position
	local nextWander = 0.0
	local lastAttack = 0.0
	while humanoid.Health > 0 and zombie:IsDescendantOf(workspace) do
		local character, targetRoot, distance = nearestPlayer(root.Position)
		local now = os.clock()
		if character and targetRoot and distance <= CHASE_RANGE then
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
			nextWander = 0
			if distance <= ATTACK_RANGE then
				humanoid:MoveTo(root.Position)
				if now - lastAttack >= ATTACK_COOLDOWN then
					lastAttack = now
					local victim = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					if victim then
						victim:TakeDamage(ATTACK_DAMAGE)
					end
				end
			else
				humanoid:MoveTo(targetRoot.Position)
			end
		else
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = 8
			if now >= nextWander then
				nextWander = now + rng:NextNumber(3, 6)
				local angle = rng:NextNumber(0, math.pi * 2)
				local radius = rng:NextNumber(5, WANDER_RADIUS)
				humanoid:MoveTo(home + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * radius, 0, math.sin(angle) * radius))
			end
		end
		task.wait(TICK)
	end
end
for _, zombie in CollectionService:GetTagged(TAG) do
	if zombie:IsA("Model") then
		task.spawn(run, zombie)
	end
end
CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(TAG):Connect(function(zombie: Instance)
	if zombie:IsA("Model") then
		task.spawn(run, zombie)
	end
end)
```

Each zombie is simply a loop with two behaviours chosen by distance to the nearest living player. The server owns the physics of the zombie (`SetNetworkOwner(nil)`), which stops clients from stuttering it or exploiting its position, and the 0.25 s think rate is plenty for movement while staying cheap with many zombies. Because the damage goes through `Humanoid:TakeDamage`, spawn ForceFields protect players.

**Plan**
- Guards (tag `Guard`) walk between numbered Parts in `workspace.Waypoints` using `Humanoid:MoveTo`, advancing when within 4 studs of the current one.
- Every 0.2 s a guard checks each player: inside view distance, inside the vision cone (angle between facing and target), then a raycast from the guard's head to the player that must hit the player's own character (so walls block sight).
- Seeing a player switches to Chase with a faster walk speed and an attack on contact; after 4 seconds without sight it goes back to the nearest waypoint and resumes patrolling.

```lua
--!strict
-- Script (ServerScriptService/PatrolGuards). Tag guard models "Guard"; put numbered waypoint Parts ("1", "2", ...) in workspace.Waypoints.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local TAG = "Guard"
local VIEW_DISTANCE = 60
local VIEW_ANGLE = 100
local LOSE_TIME = 4
local PATROL_SPEED = 10
local CHASE_SPEED = 18
local HIT_RANGE = 4
local HIT_DAMAGE = 15
local HIT_COOLDOWN = 1
local waypoints: { BasePart } = {}
for _, child in workspace:WaitForChild("Waypoints"):GetChildren() do
	if child:IsA("BasePart") and tonumber(child.Name) then
		table.insert(waypoints, child)
	end
end
table.sort(waypoints, function(a: BasePart, b: BasePart)
	return (tonumber(a.Name) or 0) < (tonumber(b.Name) or 0)
end)
local function canSee(guard: Model, root: BasePart, target: Model, targetRoot: BasePart): boolean
	local offset = targetRoot.Position - root.Position
	if offset.Magnitude > VIEW_DISTANCE then
		return false
	end
	local angle = math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(root.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(offset.Unit), -1, 1)))
	if angle > VIEW_ANGLE / 2 then
		return false
	end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { guard }
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, offset, params)
	return hit ~= nil and hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(target)
end
local function nearestWaypoint(position: Vector3): number
	local best, bestDistance = 1, math.huge
	for index, point in waypoints do
		local distance = (point.Position - position).Magnitude
		if distance < bestDistance then
			best, bestDistance = index, distance
		end
	end
	return best
end
local function run(guard: Model)
	local humanoid = guard:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = guard:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoid or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") or #waypoints == 0 then
		return
	end
	local index = nearestWaypoint(root.Position)
	local chasing = false
	local lastSeen = 0.0
	local lastHit = 0.0
	while humanoid.Health > 0 and guard:IsDescendantOf(workspace) do
		local now = os.clock()
		local seenRoot: BasePart? = nil
		local seenHumanoid: Humanoid? = nil
		for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
			local character = player.Character
			local targetRoot = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
			local targetHumanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
			if character and targetRoot and targetRoot:IsA("BasePart") and targetHumanoid and targetHumanoid.Health > 0 then
				if canSee(guard, root, character, targetRoot) then
					seenRoot, seenHumanoid = targetRoot, targetHumanoid
					break
				end
			end
		end
		if seenRoot and seenHumanoid then
			chasing = true
			lastSeen = now
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = CHASE_SPEED
			humanoid:MoveTo(seenRoot.Position)
			if (seenRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude <= HIT_RANGE and now - lastHit >= HIT_COOLDOWN then
				lastHit = now
				seenHumanoid:TakeDamage(HIT_DAMAGE)
			end
		elseif chasing and now - lastSeen < LOSE_TIME then
			humanoid:MoveTo(root.Position)
		else
			if chasing then
				chasing = false
				index = nearestWaypoint(root.Position)
			end
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = PATROL_SPEED
			local point = waypoints[index]
			local flat = Vector3.new(point.Position.X - root.Position.X, 0, point.Position.Z - root.Position.Z)
			if flat.Magnitude < 4 then
				index = index % #waypoints + 1
				point = waypoints[index]
			end
			humanoid:MoveTo(point.Position)
		end
		task.wait(0.2)
	end
end
for _, guard in CollectionService:GetTagged(TAG) do
	if guard:IsA("Model") then
		task.spawn(run, guard)
	end
end
CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(TAG):Connect(function(guard: Instance)
	if guard:IsA("Model") then
		task.spawn(run, guard)
	end
end)
```

Sight needs three things in order: the target is within range, it lies inside the cone in front of the guard (the angle between the guard's `LookVector` and the direction to the player), and an unobstructed ray reaches the player's body. A wall, crate or closed door hit first fails the last test, so hiding works. The 4-second memory window makes guards stop and look around instead of instantly forgetting you when you break line of sight.

**Plan**
- Each player gets a Pet model (a clone of `ServerStorage.Pet` if it has a PrimaryPart, otherwise a glowing ball) when their character spawns; it is anchored and moved by the script.
- Every Heartbeat the pet eases toward a goal point 5 studs behind the owner (opposite their facing) and a little above the ground with a gentle bob, and looks at its owner.
- If the pet is more than 100 studs from the owner (for example after a teleport) it jumps straight to the goal; it is removed when the character is removed or the player leaves.

```lua
--!strict
-- Script (ServerScriptService/Pets). Optional: put a Model named "Pet" with a PrimaryPart in ServerStorage; otherwise a glowing ball is used.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local FOLLOW_DISTANCE = 5
local TELEPORT_DISTANCE = 100
local HOVER_HEIGHT = 2.5
local SMOOTHING = 8
local pets: { [Player]: Model } = {}
local function createPet(): Model
	local template = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("Pet")
	if template and template:IsA("Model") and template.PrimaryPart then
		local clone = template:Clone()
		for _, descendant in clone:GetDescendants() do
			if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
				descendant.Anchored = true
				descendant.CanCollide = false
			end
		end
		return clone
	end
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "Pet"
	local body = Instance.new("Part")
	body.Name = "Body"
	body.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	body.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
	body.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	body.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 255)
	body.Anchored = true
	body.CanCollide = false
	body.Parent = model
	model.PrimaryPart = body
	return model
end
local function removePet(player: Player)
	local pet = pets[player]
	if pet then
		pet:Destroy()
		pets[player] = nil
	end
end
local function onCharacter(player: Player, character: Model)
	removePet(player)
	local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart
	local pet = createPet()
	pet:PivotTo(root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, HOVER_HEIGHT, FOLLOW_DISTANCE))
	pet:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", player.UserId)
	pet.Parent = workspace
	pets[player] = pet
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player: Player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character: Model)
		onCharacter(player, character)
	end)
	player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
		removePet(player)
	end)
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(removePet)
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
	local t = os.clock()
	for player, pet in pets do
		local character = player.Character
		local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		local primary = pet.PrimaryPart
		if root and root:IsA("BasePart") and primary then
			local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
			local flatLook = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
			flatLook = if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.01 then flatLook.Unit else Vector3.zAxis
			local goal = root.Position - flatLook * FOLLOW_DISTANCE + Vector3.new(0, HOVER_HEIGHT + math.sin(t * 3) * 0.4, 0)
			local current = primary.Position
			if (current - root.Position).Magnitude > TELEPORT_DISTANCE then
				pet:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(goal, root.Position))
			else
				local alpha = 1 - math.exp(-SMOOTHING * dt)
				local nextPosition = current:Lerp(goal, alpha)
				local faceTarget = Vector3.new(root.Position.X, nextPosition.Y, root.Position.Z)
				if (faceTarget - nextPosition).Magnitude > 0.1 then
					pet:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(nextPosition, faceTarget))
				else
					pet:PivotTo(CFrame.new(nextPosition))
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)
```

The goal point is calculated from the owner's flattened facing direction, so the pet stays behind them even when they look up or down. Exponential smoothing (`1 - exp(-k * dt)`) gives the same easing at any frame rate, and moving the pet with `PivotTo` while everything is anchored avoids physics glitches. Distances over 100 studs skip the easing and teleport the pet straight to the goal.

**Plan**
- Enemies tagged `RangedEnemy` find the nearest player within 120 studs and hold a ring of 30 studs (+-6): back away if closer, approach if farther, stand still in between.
- Every 2 seconds they fire a projectile Part that aims at where the target will be (target position plus velocity times travel time).
- All projectiles are moved by one Heartbeat loop; each step is raycast so fast projectiles cannot skip through walls, and a Humanoid hit takes 15 damage.

```lua
--!strict
-- Script (ServerScriptService/RangedEnemies). Tag enemy models (Humanoid + HumanoidRootPart) with "RangedEnemy".
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TAG = "RangedEnemy"
local KEEP_DISTANCE = 30
local TOLERANCE = 6
local SHOOT_INTERVAL = 2
local DETECT_RANGE = 120
local SPEED = 80
local DAMAGE = 15
local LIFETIME = 4
type Projectile = { part: Part, velocity: Vector3, age: number, owner: Model }
local projectiles: { Projectile } = {}
local params = RaycastParams.new()
params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
local function nearestTarget(position: Vector3): (BasePart?, number)
	local bestRoot: BasePart? = nil
	local bestDistance = math.huge
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local character = player.Character
		local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		if root and root:IsA("BasePart") and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			local distance = (root.Position - position).Magnitude
			if distance < bestDistance then
				bestRoot, bestDistance = root, distance
			end
		end
	end
	return bestRoot, bestDistance
end
local function shoot(owner: Model, origin: Vector3, targetRoot: BasePart)
	local travel = (targetRoot.Position - origin).Magnitude / SPEED
	local aim = targetRoot.Position + targetRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity * travel
	local direction = (aim - origin).Unit
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = "EnemyProjectile"
	part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	part.Size = Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 1.2)
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 60)
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.Position = origin
	part.Parent = workspace
	table.insert(projectiles, { part = part, velocity = direction * SPEED, age = 0, owner = owner })
end
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
	for i = #projectiles, 1, -1 do
		local p = projectiles[i]
		local step = p.velocity * dt
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { p.owner, p.part }
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(p.part.Position, step, params)
		p.age += dt
		if hit then
			local model = hit.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			local humanoid = if model then model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
			if humanoid then
				humanoid:TakeDamage(DAMAGE)
			end
		elseif p.age < LIFETIME then
			p.part.Position += step
			continue
		end
		p.part:Destroy()
		table.remove(projectiles, i)
	end
end)
local function run(enemy: Model)
	local humanoid = enemy:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = enemy:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoid or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end
	local lastShot = 0.0
	while humanoid.Health > 0 and enemy:IsDescendantOf(workspace) do
		local targetRoot, distance = nearestTarget(root.Position)
		if targetRoot and distance <= DETECT_RANGE then
			local away = Vector3.new(root.Position.X - targetRoot.Position.X, 0, root.Position.Z - targetRoot.Position.Z)
			away = if away.Magnitude > 0.01 then away.Unit else Vector3.xAxis
			if distance < KEEP_DISTANCE - TOLERANCE then
				humanoid:MoveTo(root.Position + away * 20)
			elseif distance > KEEP_DISTANCE + TOLERANCE then
				humanoid:MoveTo(targetRoot.Position + away * KEEP_DISTANCE)
			else
				humanoid:MoveTo(root.Position)
			end
			local now = os.clock()
			if distance <= KEEP_DISTANCE + 20 and now - lastShot >= SHOOT_INTERVAL then
				lastShot = now
				shoot(enemy, root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0), targetRoot)
			end
		end
		task.wait(0.2)
	end
end
for _, enemy in CollectionService:GetTagged(TAG) do
	if enemy:IsA("Model") then
		task.spawn(run, enemy)
	end
end
CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(TAG):Connect(function(enemy: Instance)
	if enemy:IsA("Model") then
		task.spawn(run, enemy)
	end
end)
```

The 30-stud distance band works as a thermostat: closer than 24 the enemy backs away, farther than 36 it moves in to 30 studs from the player, and in between it stands and shoots. Projectiles are anchored Parts moved by a single loop and cast along each step, which is cheaper than physics objects and cannot tunnel through thin walls; leading the target by its velocity makes the shots land on moving players.

```lua
--!strict
-- Script (ServerScriptService/BossAI). Tag the boss model (Humanoid + HumanoidRootPart) with "Boss".
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TAG = "Boss"
local PHASE_COLORS = { Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 120), Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 40), Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50) }
local PHASE_SPEED = { 12, 16, 22 }
local PROJECTILE_SPEED = 60
type Projectile = { part: Part, velocity: Vector3, age: number }
local projectiles: { Projectile } = {}
local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
local function damageRadius(position: Vector3, radius: number, damage: number, ignore: Model)
	local overlap = OverlapParams.new()
	overlap.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = { ignore }
	local hurt: { [Humanoid]: boolean } = {}
	for _, part in workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(position, radius, overlap) do
		local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		local humanoid = if model then model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil

		end
	end
end
local function fire(boss: Model, origin: Vector3, direction: Vector3, damage: number)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	part.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 40)
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.Position = origin
	part:SetAttribute("Damage", damage)
	part:SetAttribute("Owner", boss.Name)
	part.Parent = workspace
	table.insert(projectiles, { part = part, velocity = direction.Unit * PROJECTILE_SPEED, age = 0 })
end
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
	for i = #projectiles, 1, -1 do
		local p = projectiles[i]
		local step = p.velocity * dt
		rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { p.part }
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(p.part.Position, step, rayParams)
		p.age += dt
		local done = p.age > 5

			local model = hit.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")

		end
	end
end)
local function nearestPlayer(position: Vector3): (BasePart?, number)
	local best: BasePart? = nil
	local bestDistance = math.huge
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local character = player.Character
		local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		if root and root:IsA("BasePart") and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			local distance = (root.Position - position).Magnitude
			if distance < bestDistance then
				best, bestDistance = root, distance
			end
		end
	end
	return best, bestDistance
end
local function run(boss: Model)
	local humanoid = boss:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = boss:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

		return
	end
	local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
	highlight.FillTransparency = 0.7
	highlight.Parent = boss
	local phase = 0
	local nextSlam, nextVolley, nextShockwave, nextBurst = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
	while humanoid.Health > 0 and boss:IsDescendantOf(workspace) do
		local ratio = humanoid.Health / humanoid.MaxHealth
		local newPhase = if ratio > 0.66 then 1 elseif ratio > 0.33 then 2 else 3
		if newPhase ~= phase then
			phase = newPhase

			highlight.FillColor = PHASE_COLORS[phase]
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = PHASE_SPEED[phase]
		end
		local target, distance = nearestPlayer(root.Position)
		local now = os.clock()
		if target then
			humanoid:MoveTo(target.Position)
			if distance < 14 and now >= nextSlam then
				nextSlam = now + 4
				damageRadius(root.Position, 14, 20, boss)
			end
			if phase >= 2 and now >= nextVolley then
				nextVolley = now + 4
				for k = 0, 7 do
					local angle = k / 8 * math.pi * 2
					fire(boss, root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), Vector3.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle)), 12)
				end
			end
			if phase == 3 then

					nextShockwave = now + 3
					damageRadius(root.Position, 22, 25, boss)
				end
				if now >= nextBurst then

		end
		task.wait(0.2)
	end

end
for _, boss in CollectionService:GetTagged(TAG) do

	end
end
CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(TAG):Connect(function(boss: Instance)

end)
```

```lua
--!strict
-- Script (ServerScriptService/EnemySpawner). Needs ServerStorage.Enemy (Model with Humanoid + PrimaryPart) and Parts in workspace.SpawnPoints.
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local MAX_ALIVE = 10
local CHECK_INTERVAL = 1
local SPAWN_DELAY = 0.5
local CLEANUP_DELAY = 3

local template = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("Enemy") :: Model
local spawnPoints = workspace:WaitForChild("SpawnPoints")
local rng = Random.new()

local container = Instance.new("Folder")
container.Name = "Enemies"
container.Parent = workspace

local alive: { [Model]: boolean } = {}
local aliveCount = 0

local function pickSpawnPoint(): BasePart?
	local candidates: { BasePart } = {}
	for _, child in spawnPoints:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("BasePart") then
			table.insert(candidates, child)
		end
	end
	if #candidates == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	return candidates[rng:NextInteger(1, #candidates)]
end

local function forget(enemy: Model)
	if alive[enemy] then
		alive[enemy] = nil
		aliveCount -= 1
	end
end

local function spawnEnemy(): boolean
	local point = pickSpawnPoint()
	if not point then
		warn("EnemySpawner: no spawn points found")
		return false
	end
	local enemy = template:Clone()
	local humanoid = enemy:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid then
		enemy:Destroy()
		warn("EnemySpawner: template has no Humanoid")
		return false
	end
	enemy:PivotTo(point.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
	alive[enemy] = true
	aliveCount += 1
	humanoid.Died:Once(function()
		forget(enemy)
		Debris:AddItem(enemy, CLEANUP_DELAY)
	end)
	enemy.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
		if not enemy:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			forget(enemy)
		end
	end)
	enemy.Parent = container
	return true
end

while true do
	while aliveCount < MAX_ALIVE do
		if not spawnEnemy() then
			break
		end
		task.wait(SPAWN_DELAY)
	end
	task.wait(CHECK_INTERVAL)
end
```

The spawner counts enemies instead of timing waves: it only creates a new one when fewer than 10 are alive, so killing enemies faster just makes it refill faster. Each enemy removes itself from the counter when it dies or is destroyed by any other script, the small delay between spawns avoids a burst of ten at once, and a warning is printed instead of an infinite loop if the spawn points or template are missing.

**Plan**
- A LocalScript creates 40 small anchored "bird" Parts (client-side only, so they cost the server nothing) and simulates them as boids around a centre point.
- For each bird it computes three steering terms from neighbours within 25 studs: separation (move away from too-close birds), alignment (match average velocity) and cohesion (move toward the average position), plus a bounds term that turns them back toward the centre.
- All accelerations are computed first, then velocities and positions are integrated, so the update order does not matter; speed is clamped between a minimum and maximum.

```lua
--!strict
-- LocalScript (StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/BirdFlock)
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local COUNT = 40
local CENTER = Vector3.new(0, 80, 0)
local BOUNDS_RADIUS = 90
local PERCEPTION = 25
local SEPARATION_DISTANCE = 6
local MIN_SPEED = 14
local MAX_SPEED = 28
local MAX_ACCEL = 30
local W_SEPARATION, W_ALIGNMENT, W_COHESION, W_BOUNDS = 2.0, 1.0, 0.9, 1.5

type Bird = { part: Part, position: Vector3, velocity: Vector3 }
local rng = Random.new()
local birds: { Bird } = {}
local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name = "Birds"

for _ = 1, COUNT do
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Size = Vector3.new(1, 0.4, 2.2)
	part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 245)
	part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	local position = CENTER + Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(-40, 40), rng:NextNumber(-15, 15), rng:NextNumber(-40, 40))
	local velocity = rng:NextUnitVector() * rng:NextNumber(MIN_SPEED, MAX_SPEED)
	part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, position + velocity)
	part.Parent = folder
	table.insert(birds, { part = part, position = position, velocity = velocity })
end
folder.Parent = workspace

local function limit(vector: Vector3, maxLength: number): Vector3
	if vector.Magnitude > maxLength then
		return vector.Unit * maxLength
	end
	return vector
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
	local accelerations: { Vector3 } = {}
	for i, bird in birds do
		local separation, velocitySum, positionSum = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
		local neighbours = 0
		for j, other in birds do
			if i ~= j then
				local offset = other.position - bird.position
				local distance = offset.Magnitude
				if distance < PERCEPTION and distance > 0 then
					neighbours += 1
					velocitySum += other.velocity
					positionSum += other.position
					if distance < SEPARATION_DISTANCE then
						separation -= offset / (distance * distance)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		local acceleration = Vector3.zero
		if neighbours > 0 then
			local alignment = velocitySum / neighbours - bird.velocity
			local cohesion = positionSum / neighbours - bird.position
			acceleration += separation * W_SEPARATION * 60 + alignment * W_ALIGNMENT + cohesion * W_COHESION * 0.5
		end
		local toCenter = CENTER - bird.position
		if toCenter.Magnitude > BOUNDS_RADIUS * 0.8 then
			acceleration += toCenter.Unit * (toCenter.Magnitude - BOUNDS_RADIUS * 0.8) * W_BOUNDS
		end
		accelerations[i] = limit(acceleration, MAX_ACCEL)
	end

	for i, bird in birds do
		local velocity = bird.velocity + accelerations[i] * dt
		local speed = math.clamp(velocity.Magnitude, MIN_SPEED, MAX_SPEED)
		bird.velocity = if velocity.Magnitude > 0.01 then velocity.Unit * speed else bird.velocity
		bird.position += bird.velocity * dt
		bird.part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(bird.position, bird.position + bird.velocity)
	end
end)
```

Boids combine three local rules: do not crowd your neighbours, fly in the same direction as them and stay near their centre, and the flock emerges without any leader. The inverse-square separation makes birds react strongly only when very close, the minimum speed stops them hovering, and the soft boundary pushes birds back toward the centre starting at 80% of the radius so they turn smoothly instead of bouncing off a wall.

```lua

-- Script (inside the Sword Tool; the Tool needs a Part named "Handle")

local tool = script.Parent :: Tool
local DAMAGE = { 10, 12, 25 }
local COOLDOWN = 0.35
local COMBO_WINDOW = 0.9
local BOX_SIZE = Vector3.new(6, 5, 6)
local REACH = 4
local KNOCKBACK = 55

local step = 0
local lastSwing = 0.0

local function hitTargets(character: Model, root: BasePart, damage: number, knock: boolean)
	local params = OverlapParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
	local boxCFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -REACH)
	local hit: { [Humanoid]: boolean } = {}
	for _, part in workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(boxCFrame, BOX_SIZE, params) do
		local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		local humanoid = if model then model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		if model and humanoid and not hit[humanoid] and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			hit[humanoid] = true
			humanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
			local targetRoot = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if knock and targetRoot and targetRoot:IsA("BasePart") then
				targetRoot:ApplyImpulse(root.CFrame.LookVector * KNOCKBACK * targetRoot.AssemblyMass + Vector3.new(0, 20 * targetRoot.AssemblyMass, 0))
			end
		end
	end
end

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
	local character = tool.Parent
	if not character or not character:IsA("Model") then
		return
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end
	if not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) then
		return

	local now = os.clock()
	if now - lastSwing < COOLDOWN then

	end
	if now - lastSwing > COMBO_WINDOW or step >= #DAMAGE then

	step += 1

		end
	end)
end)

tool.Unequipped:Connect(function()
	step = 0
	tool:SetAttribute("ComboStep", 0)
end)
```

`Tool.Activated` fires on the server for a server Script inside the tool, so no RemoteEvent is needed and there is nothing for an exploiter to send; the only client input is the click itself, and the cooldown is enforced here. The damage check is delayed by 0.12 s to match the swing animation and is skipped if the tool was unequipped or the player died in the meantime. **Plan**
- A ModuleScript exposes `Hitbox.new(owner, size, offset)` with `:Cast(originCFrame)`, `:Reset()` and `:Destroy()`.
- `Cast` uses `GetPartBoundsInBox` at `origin * offset`, filtered to exclude the owner, and returns only Humanoids not already hit since the last `Reset`.
- Call `Cast` every frame during a swing and `Reset` when the next swing starts, so a target is never hit twice in one swing; a debug option draws the box briefly.

```lua
--!strict
-- ModuleScript (ServerScriptService/Hitbox)
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local Hitbox = {}
Hitbox.__index = Hitbox

type HitboxData = {
	owner: Model,
	size: Vector3,
	offset: CFrame,
	hit: { [Humanoid]: boolean },
	params: OverlapParams,
	debug: boolean,
}
export type Hitbox = typeof(setmetatable({} :: HitboxData, Hitbox))

function Hitbox.new(owner: Model, size: Vector3, offset: CFrame?): Hitbox
	local params = OverlapParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { owner }
	local data: HitboxData = {
		owner = owner,
		size = size,
		offset = offset or CFrame.new(0, 0, -size.Z / 2),
		hit = {},
		params = params,
		debug = false,
	}
	return setmetatable(data, Hitbox)
end

function Hitbox.SetDebug(self: Hitbox, enabled: boolean)
	self.debug = enabled
end

function Hitbox.Reset(self: Hitbox)
	table.clear(self.hit)
end

-- Returns every living Humanoid inside the box that has not been returned since the last Reset.
function Hitbox.Cast(self: Hitbox, origin: CFrame): { Humanoid }
	local boxCFrame = origin * self.offset
	local found: { Humanoid } = {}
	for _, part in workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(boxCFrame, self.size, self.params) do
		local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		local humanoid = if model then model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and not self.hit[humanoid] then
			self.hit[humanoid] = true
			table.insert(found, humanoid)
		end
	end
	if self.debug then
		local marker = Instance.new("Part")
		marker.Anchored = true
		marker.CanCollide = false
		marker.CanQuery = false
		marker.CanTouch = false
		marker.Transparency = 0.7
		marker.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
		marker.Size = self.size
		marker.CFrame = boxCFrame
		marker.Parent = workspace
		Debris:AddItem(marker, 0.15)
	end
	return found
end

function Hitbox.Destroy(self: Hitbox)
	table.clear(self.hit)
end

-- Example (server Script): per swing, Reset, then Cast each Heartbeat for 0.2 s and damage the returned Humanoids.
--   local box = Hitbox.new(character, Vector3.new(6, 5, 6)); box:Reset()
--   local found = box:Cast(root.CFrame); for _, h in found do h:TakeDamage(10) end
return Hitbox
```

Separating "what is inside the box" from "what to do about it" lets every weapon reuse the same code: swords, fists and area attacks differ only in the size, offset and what they do with the returned Humanoids. The `hit` set is the once-per-swing guarantee, and because it is cleared only by `Reset`, a fast target that stays inside the box for many frames is still reported just once.

```lua
		character:SetAttribute("Blocking", false)
		character:SetAttribute("DamageMultiplier", 1)

		character:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Blocking"):Connect(function()
			local blocking = character:GetAttribute("Blocking") == true
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = if blocking then baseSpeed * SPEED_FACTOR else baseSpeed
			character:SetAttribute("DamageMultiplier", if blocking then 1 - REDUCTION else 1)
		end)

		humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(health: number)
			if adjusting then
				return
			end
			if character:GetAttribute("Blocking") == true and health < last and health > 0 then
				adjusting = true
				humanoid.Health = health + (last - health) * REDUCTION
				adjusting = false
			end
			last = humanoid.Health
		end)
	end

	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player: Player)
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character: Model)
			setup(player, character)
		end)
	end)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
		lastToggle[player] = nil
	end)

	remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, wantsBlock: unknown)
		if typeof(wantsBlock) ~= "boolean" then
			return
		end
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		if not character or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			return
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		if wantsBlock and now - (lastToggle[player] or 0) < TOGGLE_COOLDOWN then
			return
		end
		lastToggle[player] = now
		character:SetAttribute("Blocking", wantsBlock)
	end)
else
	local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	local remote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BlockEvent") :: RemoteEvent
	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject, processed: boolean)
		if not processed and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F then
			remote:FireServer(true)
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F then
			remote:FireServer(false)
		end
	end)
end
```

Because the server decides whether the player is blocking, a client cannot claim to be blocking for free, and stopping a block is always accepted so nobody gets stuck slow. A lethal hit cannot be refunded because the Humanoid is already dead, so make your weapons multiply their damage by the target's `DamageMultiplier` attribute before calling `TakeDamage`; the health refund then only covers damage from scripts that do not.

**Plan**
- Same source file as a LocalScript (key Q sends the aim direction) and a Script (handles the remote).
- The server validates the direction vector, that the caster is alive, and a 3 s per-player cooldown, then spawns an anchored neon fireball at the caster's chest moved every Heartbeat with a raycast along each step.
- When it hits something or expires it explodes: a harmless `Explosion` for the visuals, and `GetPartBoundsInRadius` (12 studs) deals up to 45 damage, less with distance, once per Humanoid.

```lua
--!strict
-- Script (ServerScriptService/Fireball); the same source is also saved as a LocalScript in StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/Fireball
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local SPEED = 70
local LIFETIME = 3
local RADIUS = 12
local MAX_DAMAGE = 45
local COOLDOWN = 3

if RunService:IsServer() then
	local remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	remote.Name = "FireballEvent"
	remote.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	local lastCast: { [Player]: number } = {}
	type Ball = { part: Part, velocity: Vector3, age: number, owner: Model }
	local balls: { Ball } = {}

	local function explode(position: Vector3, owner: Model)
		local effect = Instance.new("Explosion")
		effect.Position = position
		effect.BlastRadius = RADIUS
		effect.BlastPressure = 0
		effect.DestroyJointRadiusPercent = 0
		effect.Parent = workspace
		local params = OverlapParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { owner }
		local done: { [Humanoid]: boolean } = {}
		for _, part in workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(position, RADIUS, params) do
			local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			local humanoid = if model then model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
			if model and humanoid and not done[humanoid] and humanoid.Health > 0 then
				done[humanoid] = true
				local pivot = model:GetPivot().Position
				local falloff = 1 - math.clamp((pivot - position).Magnitude / RADIUS, 0, 1) * 0.5
				humanoid:TakeDamage(MAX_DAMAGE * falloff)
			end
		end
	end

	remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, direction: unknown)
		if typeof(direction) ~= "Vector3" then
			return
		end
		local aim = direction :: Vector3
		if aim ~= aim or math.abs(aim.Magnitude - 1) > 0.05 then
			return
		end
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		if not character or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
			return
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - (lastCast[player] or -math.huge) < COOLDOWN then
			return
		end
		lastCast[player] = now

		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		part.Size = Vector3.new(3, 3, 3)
		part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 30)
		part.Anchored = true
		part.CanCollide = false
		part.CanQuery = false
		part.Position = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) + aim * 3
		part.Parent = workspace
		table.insert(balls, { part = part, velocity = aim * SPEED, age = 0, owner = character })
	end)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
		lastCast[player] = nil
	end)

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
		for i = #balls, 1, -1 do
			local ball = balls[i]
			local step = ball.velocity * dt
			local params = RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { ball.owner, ball.part }
			local hit = workspace:Raycast(ball.part.Position, step, params)
			ball.age += dt
			if hit or ball.age >= LIFETIME then
				explode(if hit then hit.Position else ball.part.Position, ball.owner)
				ball.part:Destroy()
				table.remove(balls, i)
			else
				ball.part.Position += step
			end
		end
	end)
else
	local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	local remote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("FireballEvent") :: RemoteEvent
	local mouse = Players.LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject, processed: boolean)
		if processed or input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Q then
			return
		end
		local character = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
		local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
			local toTarget = mouse.Hit.Position - root.Position
			if toTarget.Magnitude > 0.1 then
				remote:FireServer(toTarget.Unit)
			end
		end
	end)
end
```

The explosion is two separate jobs: the built-in `Explosion` object is only the visual (pressure and joint destruction are turned off so it cannot break characters or builds), and the radius query decides the damage, so the numbers are completely under script control. The fireball is moved by raycasting along each frame step, which keeps it from skipping through thin walls at high speed.

**Plan**
- `applyKnockback(character, direction, speed, duration)` adds an Attachment to the root part and a `LinearVelocity` pointing along a flat direction with a small upward lift, then removes both after `duration`.
- A repeated knockback replaces the old one, and the push is skipped for dead or missing characters.
- The demo section turns every Part tagged `KnockbackPad` into a launcher: touching it knocks the character away from the pad, with a per-Humanoid cooldown.

```lua
--!strict
-- Script (ServerScriptService/Knockback). Tag any Part "KnockbackPad" to test it. Other scripts can copy applyKnockback.
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local PUSH_SPEED = 60
local PUSH_TIME = 0.25
local LIFT = 0.35
local PAD_COOLDOWN = 1

local function applyKnockback(character: Model, direction: Vector3, speed: number, duration: number)
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end
	local flat = Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude < 0.01 then
		return
	end
	local velocityDirection = (flat.Unit + Vector3.new(0, LIFT, 0)).Unit

	local old = root:FindFirstChild("KnockbackVelocity")
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	local attachment = root:FindFirstChild("KnockbackAttachment")
	if not attachment then
		local created = Instance.new("Attachment")
		created.Name = "KnockbackAttachment"
		created.Parent = root
		attachment = created
	end

	local push = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
	push.Name = "KnockbackVelocity"
	push.Attachment0 = attachment :: Attachment
	push.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
	push.VelocityConstraintMode = Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Vector
	push.VectorVelocity = velocityDirection * speed
	push.MaxForce = 1e6 * math.max(root.AssemblyMass, 1)
	push.Parent = root
	Debris:AddItem(push, duration)
end

local lastHit: { [Humanoid]: number } = {}

local function setupPad(pad: Instance)
	if not pad:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end
	pad.Touched:Connect(function(other: BasePart)
		local character = other:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		if not character or not humanoid or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
			return
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - (lastHit[humanoid] or 0) < PAD_COOLDOWN then
			return
		end
		lastHit[humanoid] = now
		applyKnockback(character, root.Position - pad.Position, PUSH_SPEED, PUSH_TIME)
		humanoid.Died:Once(function()
			lastHit[humanoid] = nil
		end)
	end)
end

for _, pad in CollectionService:GetTagged("KnockbackPad") do
	setupPad(pad)
end
CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("KnockbackPad"):Connect(setupPad)
```

`LinearVelocity` holds the target speed against friction and gravity for exactly its lifetime, which gives a clean predictable shove (a one-off `ApplyImpulse` varies with mass and friction), and removing it hands control straight back to normal physics. Using a flat direction plus a small fixed lift keeps the knockback consistent whether the attacker is above or below the target.

**Plan**
- The server builds a table of numbered checkpoint Parts and connects `Touched` on each one; there are no RemoteEvents, so a client cannot report progress.
- Touching checkpoint `n` is accepted only if `n == last + 1`; a larger number counts the skipped checkpoints, rubber-bands the player to their last checkpoint and flags them, and 2+ skips or 3 flags in one run saves a ban to a DataStore and kicks.
- Speed is checked against `distance / (MAX_SPEED x 1.15)` minus a lag allowance, using the gap between the Part edges; players with the server-set `SpeedExemptUntil` attribute (launch pads, boosts, vehicles, teleports) are skipped, and `ENFORCE = false` runs in shadow mode.

```lua
--!strict
-- Script (ServerScriptService/CheckpointAntiCheat). Server only. Other server scripts set player:SetAttribute("SpeedExemptUntil", os.clock() + seconds) for boosts and teleports.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local MAX_SPEED = 16
local TOLERANCE = 1.15
local LAG_SECONDS = 0.3
local MAX_FLAGS = 3
local MAX_SKIPS = 2
local EVAL_COOLDOWN = 1
local ENFORCE = true

local banStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("AntiCheatBans_v1")
local checkpoints: { [number]: BasePart } = {}
for _, child in workspace:WaitForChild("Checkpoints"):GetChildren() do
	local index = tonumber(child.Name)
	if index and child:IsA("BasePart") then
		checkpoints[index] = child
	end
end

type Run = { last: number, lastTime: number, evalAt: number, flags: number, skips: number, log: { string } }
local runs: { [Player]: Run } = {}

local function record(player: Player, run: Run, kind: string, evidence: string)
	local line = string.format("%s %s %s", os.date("!%H:%M:%S"), kind, evidence)
	table.insert(run.log, line)
	warn(string.format("[CheckpointAC] %s (%d): %s", player.Name, player.UserId, line))
end

local function rubberBand(player: Player, index: number)
	local character = player.Character
	local target = checkpoints[math.max(index, 1)]
	if ENFORCE and character and target then
		character:PivotTo(target.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
	end
end

local function ban(player: Player, run: Run, reason: string)
	record(player, run, "BAN", reason)
	if not ENFORCE then
		return
	end
	local entry = { reason = reason, evidence = table.concat(run.log, " | "), expires = 0, at = os.time() }
	for attempt = 1, 4 do
		if pcall(function()
			banStore:SetAsync(tostring(player.UserId), entry)
		end) then
			break
		end
		task.wait(attempt)
	end
	player:Kick("Banned: " .. reason)
end

local function onTouch(index: number, hit: BasePart)
	local model = hit:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	local player = if model then Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) else nil
	local run = if player then runs[player] else nil
	if not player or not run or index <= run.last then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - run.evalAt < EVAL_COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	run.evalAt = now

	local gap = index - run.last - 1
	if gap > 0 then
		run.skips += gap
		run.flags += 1
		record(player, run, "SKIP", string.format("touched %d after %d (skipped %d)", index, run.last, gap))
		if run.skips >= MAX_SKIPS or run.flags >= MAX_FLAGS then
			ban(player, run, "Checkpoint skipping")
		else
			rubberBand(player, run.last)
		end
		return
	end

	local exempt = player:GetAttribute("SpeedExemptUntil")
	if run.last >= 1 and not (typeof(exempt) == "number" and exempt > now) then
		local from, to = checkpoints[run.last], checkpoints[index]
		local distance = math.max(0, (to.Position - from.Position).Magnitude - (from.Size.Magnitude + to.Size.Magnitude) / 2)
		local minTime = distance / (MAX_SPEED * TOLERANCE) - LAG_SECONDS
		local elapsed = now - run.lastTime
		if elapsed < minTime then
			run.flags += 1
			record(player, run, "TOO_FAST", string.format("%d->%d dist %.1f in %.2fs, minimum %.2fs", run.last, index, distance, elapsed, minTime))
			if run.flags >= MAX_FLAGS then
				ban(player, run, "Checkpoint speed")
			else
				rubberBand(player, run.last)
			end
			return
		end
	end
	run.last = index
	run.lastTime = now
end

for index, part in checkpoints do
	part.Touched:Connect(function(hit: BasePart)
		onTouch(index, hit)
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player: Player)
	local ok, banned = pcall(function()
		return banStore:GetAsync(tostring(player.UserId))
	end)
	if ok and banned then
		player:Kick("You are banned.")
		return
	end
	runs[player] = { last = 0, lastTime = os.clock(), evalAt = 0, flags = 0, skips = 0, log = {} }
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
	runs[player] = nil
end)
```

Because the server only trusts its own `Touched` events and the server clock, there is nothing for an exploiter to forge except moving fast or teleporting, which is exactly what the time check measures. The edge-to-edge distance and the lag allowance make the minimum time conservative, and the first violation only rubber-bands, so an honest player with a lag spike is moved back rather than banned. Set `ENFORCE = false` for a few days first to read the logs before turning bans on.

**Plan**
- A Heartbeat accumulator samples every character's root position every 0.25 s and computes the real time since the previous sample, so a stalled server tick enlarges the allowance instead of causing a false flag.
- The allowed horizontal distance comes from the server's `Humanoid.WalkSpeed` times 1.15; excess distance goes into a leaky "debt" that drains whenever the player moves legitimately, so lag spikes are forgiven but sustained speed is caught.
- A violation rubber-bands to the last valid position and adds a strike (decaying over time); kick and ban at higher counts, with evidence logged, and seated, teleported or exempt players reset their baseline.

```lua
--!strict
-- Script (ServerScriptService/SpeedDetector). Server scripts that move a player on purpose set player:SetAttribute("ServerTeleportAt", os.clock()) or ("SpeedExemptUntil", os.clock() + seconds).
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local SAMPLE_INTERVAL = 0.25
local SPEED_TOLERANCE = 1.15
local SLACK_STUDS = 2
local DEBT_LIMIT = 10
local DECAY_SECONDS = 30
local KICK_STRIKES = 5
local BAN_STRIKES = 8
local ENFORCE = true

local banStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("AntiCheatBans_v1")
type Track = { lastPos: Vector3, lastTime: number, validPos: Vector3, debt: number }
local tracks: { [Player]: Track } = {}
local strikes: { [Player]: number } = {}
local lastStrike: { [Player]: number } = {}

local function punish(player: Player, reason: string, evidence: string)
	local now = os.clock()
	local decayed = math.floor((now - (lastStrike[player] or now)) / DECAY_SECONDS)
	local count = math.max(0, (strikes[player] or 0) - decayed) + 1
	strikes[player], lastStrike[player] = count, now
	warn(string.format("[SpeedAC] %s (%d) strike %d %s | %s", player.Name, player.UserId, count, reason, evidence))
	if not ENFORCE then
		return
	end
	if count >= BAN_STRIKES then
		for attempt = 1, 3 do
			if pcall(function()
				banStore:SetAsync(tostring(player.UserId), { reason = reason, evidence = evidence, expires = 0, at = os.time() })
			end) then
				break
			end
			task.wait(attempt)
		end
		player:Kick("Banned: " .. reason)
	elseif count >= KICK_STRIKES then
		player:Kick("Kicked: " .. reason)
	end
end

local function exempt(player: Player, humanoid: Humanoid, since: number): boolean
	local now = os.clock()
	local untilTime = player:GetAttribute("SpeedExemptUntil")
	local teleportAt = player:GetAttribute("ServerTeleportAt")
	if typeof(untilTime) == "number" and untilTime > now then
		return true
	end
	if typeof(teleportAt) == "number" and teleportAt >= since then
		return true
	end
	return humanoid.SeatPart ~= nil or humanoid.Health <= 0
end

local accumulator = 0.0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
	accumulator += dt
	if accumulator < SAMPLE_INTERVAL then
		return
	end
	accumulator = 0
	local now = os.clock()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		if not character or not humanoid or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
			tracks[player] = nil
			continue
		end
		local track = tracks[player]
		if not track or exempt(player, humanoid, track.lastTime) then
			tracks[player] = { lastPos = root.Position, lastTime = now, validPos = root.Position, debt = 0 }
			continue
		end
		local elapsed = now - track.lastTime
		local delta = root.Position - track.lastPos
		local horizontal = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z).Magnitude
		local allowed = humanoid.WalkSpeed * SPEED_TOLERANCE * elapsed + SLACK_STUDS
		track.debt = math.max(0, track.debt + horizontal - allowed)
		if track.debt > DEBT_LIMIT then
			punish(player, "Speed hack", string.format("moved %.1f studs in %.2fs (%.1f/s), allowed %.1f, WalkSpeed %.1f, debt %.1f, at %s",
				horizontal, elapsed, horizontal / elapsed, allowed, humanoid.WalkSpeed, track.debt, tostring(root.Position)))
			if ENFORCE then
				root.CFrame = CFrame.new(track.validPos) * root.CFrame.Rotation
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			end
			track.debt = 0
			track.lastPos = if ENFORCE then track.validPos else root.Position
		else
			if track.debt < DEBT_LIMIT / 2 then
				track.validPos = root.Position
			end
			track.lastPos = root.Position
		end
		track.lastTime = now
	end
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
	tracks[player], strikes[player], lastStrike[player] = nil, nil, nil
end)
```

The detector never reads anything the client sends: position comes from the replicated root part, and `WalkSpeed` is the server's value, which a client's local change does not touch. The leaky debt is what makes it lag-safe: a hitch produces one large step that is absorbed by the longer measured interval, while a real speed hack keeps adding to the debt every sample until it passes the limit. The first offences only rubber-band and add a strike, and strikes decay, so honest players are never banned for a single bad reading.

**Plan**
- Every Heartbeat the server compares each player's current root position with their last valid one and raycasts between them at waist height, excluding all characters and ignoring `CanCollide = false` parts via `RespectCanCollide`.
- Only anchored solid parts count as walls (so physics objects pushed around cannot cause false positives), parts tagged `NoclipIgnore` are skipped, and server teleports, seats and fresh spawns reset the baseline.
- A hit moves the player back to the last valid position and adds a decaying strike; kick at 6 strikes and a saved ban at 10, with the wall, positions and distance logged as evidence.

```lua
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()

			end
		else
			lastValid[player] = current

	end
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
```

The ray runs from the last position the server considered valid, so teleporting through a wall in one step and sliding through it slowly both hit the same surface. Characters and non-colliding parts (open doors, triggers, decorations) are excluded by the filter, only anchored parts count so crates and ragdolls cannot cause strikes, and teleports, seats and respawns restart the baseline so honest players are never flagged for being moved by the game.

**Plan**
- Every 0.2 s the server raycasts down from each character's root to decide if the player is grounded, and tracks airborne time, the height above the last grounded point, and the server's own jump limits (`JumpPower` or `JumpHeight`, `workspace.Gravity`).
- It flags hovering (airborne longer than a jump allows while barely moving vertically), climbing above the maximum jump height, and impossible upward speed; ladders (Climbing), swimming, seats, falling with downward velocity, and parts tagged `JumpPad` (which grant a timed exemption on touch) are ignored.
- A violation rubber-bands to the last grounded position and adds a decaying strike; kick and ban at higher counts with evidence logged.

A legitimate jump has a predictable maximum height and air time derived from the server's own jump value and gravity, so anything beyond those limits while not climbing, swimming, seated or on a tagged pad is suspect. Falling is allowed because the hover test only fires when vertical speed is near zero, and the generous tolerances plus a strike counter that decays mean one odd reading from lag only moves the player back.

**Plan**
- Every 0.1 s the server compares each root position with the previous sample: the horizontal step may not exceed `WalkSpeed x 1.15 x elapsed` plus a base allowance, and the vertical step has its own limit (falling is fast, climbing is not).
- Server-initiated teleports are whitelisted by a `ServerTeleportAt` player attribute holding `os.clock()` set before the move; the script also sets it itself on every spawn.
- A violation moves the player back, adds a decaying strike, and kicks/bans at higher counts, logging step size, limit and positions.

Marking happens before the game moves a player, and the check allows a short grace window after the mark, so spawns, spawn pads and `TeleportService` arrivals are never flagged. Anything that moves a player farther than speed and time allow, without that mark, is by definition client-initiated, so it is reverted and counted; only repeated offences escalate.

**Plan**
- `SecureRemote.event` and `SecureRemote.func` create the remote in `ReplicatedStorage.SecureRemotes` and wrap the handler so every call first passes a schema check (exact argument count, types, ranges, string length, Instance class and location) and a per-player token-bucket rate limit.
- Malformed or flooding calls are dropped, add a decaying strike for that player, and are logged with the remote name and reason; enough strikes kick the player.
- `installExamples()` shows two protected remotes: `BuyItem` (item id + quantity checked against a server price table and the player's coins) and `DealDamage` (target must be a living Humanoid, in range, weapon held, cooldown).

```lua
--!strict
-- ModuleScript (ServerScriptService/SecureRemote). Use: require(...).installExamples() from a server Script.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

export type Rule = { kind: string, min: number?, max: number?, integer: boolean?, maxLength: number?, class: string? }
local SecureRemote = {}
local KICK_STRIKES = 10
local DECAY_SECONDS = 20

local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name = "SecureRemotes"
folder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
local buckets: { [Player]: { [string]: { tokens: number, time: number } } } = {}
local strikes: { [Player]: { count: number, time: number } } = {}

function SecureRemote.number(min: number, max: number, integer: boolean?): Rule
	return { kind = "number", min = min, max = max, integer = integer }
end
function SecureRemote.string(maxLength: number): Rule
	return { kind = "string", maxLength = maxLength }
end
function SecureRemote.instance(class: string): Rule
	return { kind = "Instance", class = class }
end

local function addStrike(player: Player, remote: string, reason: string)
	local entry = strikes[player] or { count = 0, time = os.clock() }
	entry.count = math.max(0, entry.count - math.floor((os.clock() - entry.time) / DECAY_SECONDS)) + 1
	entry.time = os.clock()
	strikes[player] = entry
	warn(string.format("[SecureRemote] %s (%d) %s: %s (strike %d)", player.Name, player.UserId, remote, reason, entry.count))
	if entry.count >= KICK_STRIKES then
		player:Kick("Too many invalid requests.")
	end
end

local function check(rules: { Rule }, args: { n: number }): string?
	if args.n ~= #rules then
		return "wrong argument count " .. args.n
	end
	for i, rule in rules do
		local value = (args :: any)[i]
		if typeof(value) ~= rule.kind then
			return string.format("arg %d: expected %s got %s", i, rule.kind, typeof(value))
		elseif rule.kind == "number" then
			local n = value :: number
			if n ~= n or n < (rule.min or -math.huge) or n > (rule.max or math.huge) or (rule.integer and n % 1 ~= 0) then
				return string.format("arg %d: number out of range", i)
			end
		elseif rule.kind == "string" and #(value :: string) > (rule.maxLength or 100) then
			return string.format("arg %d: string too long", i)
		elseif rule.kind == "Instance" then
			local instance = value :: Instance
			if not instance:IsA(rule.class or "Instance") or not instance:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
				return string.format("arg %d: bad instance", i)
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function allowed(player: Player, name: string, rate: number, burst: number): boolean
	local set = buckets[player] or {}
	buckets[player] = set
	local bucket = set[name] or { tokens = burst, time = os.clock() }
	set[name] = bucket
	bucket.tokens = math.min(burst, bucket.tokens + (os.clock() - bucket.time) * rate)
	bucket.time = os.clock()
	if bucket.tokens < 1 then
		return false
	end
	bucket.tokens -= 1
	return true
end

local function guard(player: Player, name: string, rules: { Rule }, rate: number, burst: number, ...: any): boolean
	if not allowed(player, name, rate, burst) then
		addStrike(player, name, "rate limit exceeded")
		return false
	end
	local problem = check(rules, table.pack(...))
	if problem then
		addStrike(player, name, problem)
		return false
	end
	return true
end

function SecureRemote.event(name: string, rules: { Rule }, rate: number, burst: number, handler: (Player, ...any) -> ())
	local remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	remote.Name = name
	remote.Parent = folder
	remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, ...: any)
		if guard(player, name, rules, rate, burst, ...) then
			handler(player, ...)
		end
	end)
end

function SecureRemote.func(name: string, rules: { Rule }, rate: number, burst: number, handler: (Player, ...any) -> any)
	local remote = Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
	remote.Name = name
	remote.OnServerInvoke = function(player: Player, ...: any): any
		if guard(player, name, rules, rate, burst, ...) then
			return handler(player, ...)
		end
		return nil
	end
	remote.Parent = folder
end

function SecureRemote.installExamples()
	local prices: { [string]: number } = { Potion = 25, Sword = 150 }
	SecureRemote.func("BuyItem", { SecureRemote.string(32), SecureRemote.number(1, 10, true) }, 1, 3, function(player: Player, item: any, quantity: any)
		local cost = prices[item :: string]
		local coins = player:GetAttribute("Coins")
		if not cost or typeof(coins) ~= "number" or coins < cost * (quantity :: number) then
			return false
		end
		player:SetAttribute("Coins", coins - cost * (quantity :: number))
		return true
	end)
	local cooldowns: { [Player]: number } = {}
	SecureRemote.event("DealDamage", { SecureRemote.instance("Humanoid") }, 4, 4, function(player: Player, target: any)
		local character = player.Character
		local tool = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") else nil
		local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		local targetRoot = (target :: Humanoid).Parent and (target :: Humanoid).Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not tool or not root or not targetRoot or not targetRoot:IsA("BasePart") or not root:IsA("BasePart") or (target :: Humanoid).Health <= 0 then
			return

		if os.clock() - (cooldowns[player] or 0) < 0.4 or (root.Position - targetRoot.Position).Magnitude > 14 then
			return

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
```
